I love Colombia here at 2-1, and it might just be my favorite Group winner bet of the tournament.

Egypt at FIFA World Cup 2026 — Player to watch out for, Tactics, Predicted playing XI - Sportstar
highlights:
Egypt at FIFA World Cup 2026 — Player to watch out for, Tactics, Predicted playing XI - Sportstar
[...]
# Egypt FIFA World Cup 2026 preview — Mohamed Salah looks to inspire Pharaos to WC success
[...]
## Egypt’s challenge will be balance. It has the attacking quality to hurt Belgium and Iran, but must avoid becoming stretched in transition at the FIFA World Cup 2026.
[...]
Egypt enters Group G with a strange contrast: a country with deep football history, but very little World Cup joy. It has reached the tournament before, but never won a match on the biggest stage. That statistic will follow Hassan’s side into North America, particularly because this group gives Egypt a real chance to change it.
[...]
The opening match against Belgium in Seattle will be the hardest on paper, but it also offers Egypt an opportunity. A draw there would immediately alter the group.
[...]
Even a narrow defeat would not be fatal if Egypt can respond against New Zealand in Vancouver. The final match against Iran in Seattle could become a direct fight for second place or a place among the best third-placed teams.
[...]
The reason for Egypt’s belief is obvious. Salah remains its biggest figure, but this is no longer a side that depends only on him. Marmoush gives Egypt pace and direct running through central areas, while Trezeguet, Zizo and Emam Ashour add options around the box.
[...]
Egypt’s challenge will be balance. It has the attacking quality to hurt Belgium and Iran, but must avoid becoming stretched in transition. If it can keep matches tight and let Salah and Marmoush decide moments, a first World Cup win may not be the limit.
[...]
#### Player to watch out for: Mohamed Salah
[...]
Salah carries Egypt’s hopes again, but this time with better attacking support around him. His movement from the right, finishing on his left foot and ability to create under pressure make him the player most likely to decide Egypt’s biggest matches.
[...]
Hossam Hassan brings stature, emotion and a deep connection with Egyptian football. One of the country’s greatest players, he has tried to give the national team more directness and personality. His challenge will be to keep Egypt compact without reducing the attacking threat around Salah and Marmoush.
[...]
#### Egypt’s Predicted XI (4-2-3-1):
[...]
Mohamed El Shenawy; Mohamed Hany, Mohamed Abdelmonem, Yasser Ibrahim, Ahmed Fatouh; Marwan Attia, Hamdy Fathy; Mohamed Salah, Emam Ashour, Mahmoud Trezeguet; Omar Marmoush.
